## Change

Describe the user-visible outcome and why it is needed.

## Validation

- [ ] Relevant local tests pass.
- [ ] Documentation and generated assets are current.
- [ ] No credentials, private logs, prompts, or response bodies are included.

## Security review

- [ ] I reviewed changes to authentication, network binding, proxy routing,
      command execution, persistence, cleanup, installers, dependencies, and
      release workflows.
- [ ] New dependencies have a documented source, owner, version policy, and
      reason for inclusion.
- [ ] Security-boundary changes update the threat model and include negative
      tests, or this change does not alter a security boundary.
- [ ] Any scanner suppression has an owner, justification, and expiry date.
